# optimizelycmssaas_manifest (Data Source)

Exports the content model (locales, property groups, content types, display templates) as a manifest. Useful for diffing environments; importing a manifest is intentionally not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Export the content model, e.g. to diff two environments.
data "optimizelycmssaas_manifest" "model" {
  sections          = ["contentTypes", "locales"]
  include_read_only = false
}

output "content_type_count" {
  value = length(jsondecode(data.optimizelycmssaas_manifest.model.json).contentTypes)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_read_only` (Boolean) Include read-only (system) resources.
- `sections` (List of String) Sections to include; all when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The manifest as JSON (decode with jsondecode).
